description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. One complete chain for blocks 0 to 99. Malformed (clause 7), 10 single events: missing section, missing method (twice, identical copies, never deduplicated), missing block_hash, missing index, index -1, index true (a boolean is not an integer), empty section, block_number "19" (a string), and an entry that is not an object. Two duplicate groups disagree (block 20 index 0: EscrowOpened versus EscrowReleased; block 21 index 0: account synthetic-alice versus synthetic-bob), so each counts once as malformed and nowhere else, with 1 copy dropped each (clause 9): 12 malformed in all. Blocks 150 and 160 are outside the page range and the request, so they are skipped, not malformed, even though block 160 has no section (clauses 4 and 10). An EscrowReleased with block_number null is kept and counts (clause 4). An EscrowOpened with data null is not malformed and has no account. Expected: complete true, status complete; covered 0 to 99; gaps none; totals escrows_opened 2, escrows_released 1, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 2; excluded_other_genesis 0; malformed_dropped 12; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1).
